subtitle: English Topics 4
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In English Topics 4, students will acquire English communication skills by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will gain confidence in speaking and improve fluency and accuracy. They will also acquire effective language learning techniques.
advice: The class will be conducted using the followings topics: Live Escalate Book 2: Trekking Unit 5 What’s on Your Playlist? Unit 6 At the Movies Unit 7 Technology in Daily Life Unit 8 Social Network Each class consists of active learning activities such as pair work and group work. Students are expected to use English enthusiastically and cooperate with others. It is necessary to check the e-syllabus or Moodle and student portal site before each class for homework materials and listen to the audio files that accompany the textbook. Students must bring their textbook to every class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

activityGoals.body: Can carry out simple conversations and answer questions using the target expressions.

Becomes an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Speaking: Carry out simple conversations and answer questions regarding the topics using the target expressions orally including details and opinions. ・Listening: Listen and understand the content of each unit perfectly. ・Reading: Understand the main points of the text completely. ・Vocabulary & grammar: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them appropriately. ・Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Speaking: Carry out simple conversations and answer questions regarding the topic using the target expressions orally in simple sentences. ・Listening: Listen and understand the overall content of the unit. ・Reading: Understand the main points of the text. ・Vocabulary & grammar: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and, though not perfectly, use them to form simple sentences. ・Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.

lessons.assignments: Prepare for the Group Presenta tion
